title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (동사 수식) - diligently
explanation: 동사 'worked'를 수식하는 자리에는 부사가 와야 한다. diligent(형용사), diligence(명사), diligences(명사 복수)는 동사를 수식할 수 없다.
correctExample: The marketing team worked diligently to complete the promotional campaign before the product launch date.
incorrectExample: The marketing team worked diligent to complete the promotional campaign before the product launch date.
tip: 동사 + ___ → 부사(-ly) 선택

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (소유격 뒤)
explanation: 소유격 'their' 뒤에는 명사가 와야 한다. appreciate(동사), appreciative(형용사), appreciably(부사)는 소유격 뒤에 올 수 없다.
correctExample: The board of directors expressed their appreciation for the creative solutions proposed by the design team.
incorrectExample: The board of directors expressed their appreciative for the creative solutions proposed by the design team.
tip: 소유격(their/his/her) + ___ → 명사

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (be동사 보어) - beneficial
explanation: be동사 'was' 뒤 보어 자리에는 형용사가 온다. benefit(명사/동사), beneficially(부사), benefiting(동명사)은 보어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The new employee training program was beneficial to all staff members who participated in the workshop sessions.
incorrectExample: The new employee training program was benefit to all staff members who participated in the workshop sessions.
tip: be동사 + ___ → 형용사(보어)

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (주어)
explanation: 관사 'The' + ___ + 'of' 구조에서 빈칸에는 명사가 와야 한다. complete(형용사/동사), completely(부사), completing(동명사)은 부적절하다.
correctExample: The completion of the office renovation project is expected by the end of this quarter according to the schedule.
incorrectExample: The complete of the office renovation project is expected by the end of this quarter according to the schedule.
tip: The + ___ + of → 명사

title: 시제 - 단순 과거
explanation: 'last month'라는 과거 시점 부사구가 있으므로 단순 과거 시제 'submitted'를 사용해야 한다. submits(현재), will submit(미래), has submitted(현재완료)는 과거 시점과 어울리지 않는다.
correctExample: The project manager submitted the final budget report to the finance department last month for approval.
incorrectExample: The project manager has submitted the final budget report to the finance department last month for approval.
tip: last month/year/week → 단순 과거(V-ed)

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (명사 수식) - comprehensive
explanation: 명사 'analysis' 앞에서 수식하는 역할은 형용사가 한다. comprehend(동사), comprehensively(부사), comprehension(명사)은 명사 앞 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The research team conducted a comprehensive analysis of the market trends before launching the new product line.
incorrectExample: The research team conducted a comprehensively analysis of the market trends before launching the new product line.
tip: a/an/the + ___ + 명사 → 형용사

title: 시제 - 현재 시제 (일반적 사실)
explanation: 회사 정책은 일반적 사실이므로 현재 시제 'requires'를 사용한다. required(과거), will require(미래), has required(현재완료)는 일반적 사실을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The company policy requires all employees to attend the mandatory safety training session every six months.
incorrectExample: The company policy required all employees to attend the mandatory safety training session every six months.
tip: 일반적 사실/규칙 → 현재 시제

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (형용사 수식) - particularly
explanation: 형용사 'important'를 수식하는 역할은 부사가 한다. particular(형용사), particularity(명사), particularize(동사)는 형용사를 수식할 수 없다.
correctExample: Maintaining accurate financial records is particularly important for companies that operate in multiple countries.
incorrectExample: Maintaining accurate financial records is particular important for companies that operate in multiple countries.
tip: ___ + 형용사 → 부사

title: 대명사 - 소유격
explanation: 명사 'annual performance review' 앞에서 소유를 나타내는 소유격 'their'가 필요하다. them(목적격), they(주격), themselves(재귀대명사)는 명사 앞 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: All employees are required to complete their annual performance review forms before the December deadline.
incorrectExample: All employees are required to complete them annual performance review forms before the December deadline.
tip: ___ + 명사 → 소유격(their/his/her/its)

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (전치사 목적어)
explanation: 전치사 'for' 뒤에는 명사가 와야 한다. authorize(동사), authorized(형용사/과거분사), authoritatively(부사)는 전치사의 목적어가 될 수 없다.
correctExample: The department head must obtain authorization for any purchase order that exceeds the five-thousand-dollar limit.
incorrectExample: The department head must obtain authorize for any purchase order that exceeds the five-thousand-dollar limit.
tip: 전치사(for/of/in) + ___ → 명사

title: 시제 - 미래 시제 (will)
explanation: 'next week'라는 미래 시점 부사구가 있으므로 미래 시제 'will begin'을 사용해야 한다. began(과거), begins(현재), has begun(현재완료)은 미래 시점과 어울리지 않는다.
correctExample: The new employee orientation program will begin next week at the main conference hall on the second floor.
incorrectExample: The new employee orientation program began next week at the main conference hall on the second floor.
tip: next week/month/year → will + 동사원형

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (문장 전체 수식)
explanation: 문장 전체를 수식하는 부사 'Unfortunately'가 필요하다. Unfortunate(형용사), Misfortune(명사), Unfortunates(명사 복수)는 문장 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: Unfortunately, the delivery of the office supplies has been delayed due to severe weather conditions in the region.
incorrectExample: Unfortunate, the delivery of the office supplies has been delayed due to severe weather conditions in the region.
tip: ___,  + 완전한 문장 → 문장 수식 부사

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (명사 수식) - significant
explanation: 명사 'growth' 앞에서 수식하는 자리에는 형용사 'significant'가 온다. significance(명사), significantly(부사), signify(동사)는 명사 앞 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The company reported significant growth in its overseas sales division during the third quarter of this fiscal year.
incorrectExample: The company reported significantly growth in its overseas sales division during the third quarter of this fiscal year.
tip: ___ + 명사 → 형용사

title: 전치사 - 시간 (by)
explanation: 마감 시점을 나타낼 때 전치사 'by'를 사용한다. until(~까지 계속), since(~이래로), for(~동안)는 마감 시점을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: All department budget proposals must be submitted to the finance team by the end of this month without exception.
incorrectExample: All department budget proposals must be submitted to the finance team until the end of this month without exception.
tip: 마감/기한 + ___ + 시점 → by

title: 수동태 - 기본 (be + p.p.)
explanation: 주어 'The report'가 배포되는 대상이므로 수동태 'was distributed'를 사용한다. distributed(능동 과거), distributes(능동 현재), has distributing(문법 오류)은 부적절하다.
correctExample: The quarterly financial report was distributed to all senior managers at the beginning of each review period.
incorrectExample: The quarterly financial report distributed to all senior managers at the beginning of each review period.
tip: 주어가 동작의 대상 → be + p.p.(수동태)

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (동사 목적어)
explanation: 동사 'received' 뒤 목적어 자리에는 명사가 와야 한다. confirm(동사), confirmed(형용사/과거분사), confirmatory(형용사)는 목적어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The customer received confirmation of the order shipment via email within twenty-four hours of the purchase.
incorrectExample: The customer received confirm of the order shipment via email within twenty-four hours of the purchase.
tip: 동사 + ___ → 명사(목적어)

title: 접속사 - because (이유)
explanation: 뒤에 주어+동사 절이 오므로 접속사 'because'가 필요하다. because of(전치사구), due to(전치사구), owing to(전치사구)는 뒤에 명사가 온다.
correctExample: The product launch was postponed because the marketing materials had not been finalized by the design department.
incorrectExample: The product launch was postponed because of the marketing materials had not been finalized by the design department.
tip: ___ + S + V → 접속사(because/although/since)

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (보어 - remain)
explanation: remain은 연결동사이므로 보어 자리에 형용사 'competitive'가 와야 한다. competition(명사), competitively(부사), compete(동사)는 보어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The company must remain competitive in the global market by investing in research and development every year.
incorrectExample: The company must remain competition in the global market by investing in research and development every year.
tip: 연결동사(remain/become/stay) + ___ → 형용사

title: 전치사 - for (기간)
explanation: 기간(three years)과 함께 쓸 때는 전치사 'for'를 사용한다. during(~하는 동안), since(~이래로), within(~이내에)는 기간 표현에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Ms. Chen has been working as a senior analyst in the finance department for more than three years now.
incorrectExample: Ms. Chen has been working as a senior analyst in the finance department during more than three years now.
tip: for + 기간(three years, two months)

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (동사구 수식)
explanation: 동사구 'increased'를 수식하는 자리에는 부사 'steadily'가 필요하다. steady(형용사), steadiness(명사), steadied(동사 과거)는 동사 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: Sales of the new product line have steadily increased since the advertising campaign was launched in January.
incorrectExample: Sales of the new product line have steady increased since the advertising campaign was launched in January.
tip: have/has + ___ + p.p. → 부사

title: 수동태 - 현재 시제
explanation: 주어 'Employees'가 요청받는 대상이므로 수동태 'are asked'를 사용한다. asked(능동 과거), asking(진행형), have asking(문법 오류)은 부적절하다.
correctExample: Employees are asked to submit their vacation requests at least two weeks in advance to the human resources department.
incorrectExample: Employees asking to submit their vacation requests at least two weeks in advance to the human resources department.
tip: 주어가 동작 대상 + 현재 → are/is + p.p.

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (관사 뒤)
explanation: 관사 'an' 뒤에는 명사가 와야 한다. inspect(동사), inspecting(동명사), inspector(명사, 사람)는 관사 뒤 이 문맥에서 부적절하다.
correctExample: The factory manager scheduled an inspection of all production equipment to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
incorrectExample: The factory manager scheduled an inspect of all production equipment to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
tip: a/an + ___ → 명사

title: 시제 - 현재 진행형
explanation: 'currently'라는 현재 진행 부사가 있으므로 현재 진행형 'is developing'을 사용한다. developed(과거), develops(현재 단순), will develop(미래)은 현재 진행 상황을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The engineering team is currently developing a new software application to streamline the inventory management process.
incorrectExample: The engineering team currently developed a new software application to streamline the inventory management process.
tip: currently/now/at the moment → be + V-ing(현재 진행)

title: 전치사 - in (장소)
explanation: 도시나 국가 등 넓은 장소에는 전치사 'in'을 사용한다. at(좁은 장소), on(표면/위), by(근처)는 도시 앞에 쓰기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The annual shareholders meeting will be held in Tokyo at the Grand Hotel conference center on March fifteenth.
incorrectExample: The annual shareholders meeting will be held at Tokyo at the Grand Hotel conference center on March fifteenth.
tip: 도시/국가 앞 → in

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (명사 수식) - suitable
explanation: 명사 'candidate' 앞에서 수식하는 역할은 형용사 'suitable'가 한다. suit(동사/명사), suitably(부사), suitability(명사)는 명사 앞 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The hiring committee is looking for a suitable candidate who has at least five years of experience in project management.
incorrectExample: The hiring committee is looking for a suitably candidate who has at least five years of experience in project management.
tip: a/the + ___ + 명사 → 형용사

title: 접속사 - although (양보)
explanation: 뒤에 주어+동사 절이 오면서 양보의 의미이므로 접속사 'Although'가 필요하다. Despite(전치사), In spite of(전치사), Regardless(부사)는 뒤에 절이 올 수 없다.
correctExample: Although the budget was limited, the marketing department successfully launched the new advertising campaign on schedule.
incorrectExample: Despite the budget was limited, the marketing department successfully launched the new advertising campaign on schedule.
tip: ___ + S + V(절) → 접속사(Although/Because/When)

title: 대명사 - 목적격
explanation: 동사 'contact'의 목적어 자리에는 목적격 대명사 'her'가 필요하다. she(주격), hers(소유대명사), herself(재귀대명사)는 일반 목적어 자리에 부적절하다.
correctExample: If you have any questions about the new attendance policy, please contact her at the human resources office directly.
incorrectExample: If you have any questions about the new attendance policy, please contact she at the human resources office directly.
tip: 동사 + ___ → 목적격(him/her/them/us)

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (과거분사 수식)
explanation: 과거분사 'organized'를 수식하는 자리에는 부사 'efficiently'가 필요하다. efficient(형용사), efficiency(명사), efficiencies(명사 복수)는 분사를 수식할 수 없다.
correctExample: The warehouse has been efficiently organized to maximize storage capacity and improve the speed of order fulfillment.
incorrectExample: The warehouse has been efficient organized to maximize storage capacity and improve the speed of order fulfillment.
tip: be + ___ + p.p. → 부사

title: 시제 - 현재완료 (since)
explanation: 'since 2020'이라는 과거 시점 이래의 계속을 나타내므로 현재완료 'has served'를 사용한다. served(과거), serves(현재), will serve(미래)는 since와 함께 쓸 수 없다.
correctExample: Mr. Park has served as the regional sales director for the Asia-Pacific division since January of last year.
incorrectExample: Mr. Park served as the regional sales director for the Asia-Pacific division since January of last year.
tip: since + 과거시점 → have/has + p.p.(현재완료)

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (주어 자리)
explanation: 문장의 주어 자리에는 명사 'Attendance'가 와야 한다. Attend(동사), Attentive(형용사), Attentively(부사)는 주어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: Attendance at the annual company meeting is mandatory for all employees regardless of their department or position.
incorrectExample: Attend at the annual company meeting is mandatory for all employees regardless of their department or position.
tip: ___ + 전치사/동사 → 주어 = 명사

title: 전치사 - during (기간 중)
explanation: 'the meeting'이라는 명사 앞에서 '~하는 동안'을 나타내므로 전치사 'during'을 사용한다. while(접속사), for(기간), when(접속사)은 명사 앞에 직접 쓸 수 없거나 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: Several important announcements were made during the quarterly staff meeting held at the main office yesterday morning.
incorrectExample: Several important announcements were made while the quarterly staff meeting held at the main office yesterday morning.
tip: ___ + 명사(구) → 전치사(during/despite/because of)

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (be동사 보어) - available
explanation: be동사 'is' 뒤 보어 자리에는 형용사 'available'이 와야 한다. avail(동사), availability(명사), availing(동명사)은 보어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The conference room on the third floor is available for booking from nine in the morning until five in the afternoon.
incorrectExample: The conference room on the third floor is availability for booking from nine in the morning until five in the afternoon.
tip: be + ___ → 형용사(보어)

title: 수동태 - 조동사 수동
explanation: 주어 'invoices'가 처리되는 대상이므로 조동사 수동태 'should be processed'를 사용한다. should process(능동), should processing(문법 오류), should been processed(문법 오류)는 부적절하다.
correctExample: All invoices should be processed within five business days of receipt to maintain good relationships with our vendors.
incorrectExample: All invoices should process within five business days of receipt to maintain good relationships with our vendors.
tip: 주어가 동작 대상 + 조동사 → 조동사 + be + p.p.

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (형용사 뒤)
explanation: 형용사 'additional' 뒤에는 명사 'information'이 와야 한다. inform(동사), informative(형용사), informally(부사)는 형용사 뒤에 올 수 없다.
correctExample: For additional information about the upcoming workshop, please visit our company website or contact the training center.
incorrectExample: For additional inform about the upcoming workshop, please visit our company website or contact the training center.
tip: 형용사 + ___ → 명사

title: 접속사 - before (시간)
explanation: 뒤에 주어+동사 절이 오면서 시간 순서를 나타내므로 접속사 'before'가 필요하다. prior to(전치사구), ahead of(전치사구), previously(부사)는 절 앞에 올 수 없다.
correctExample: Please review all the attached documents carefully before you sign the employment contract with the staffing agency.
incorrectExample: Please review all the attached documents carefully prior to you sign the employment contract with the staffing agency.
tip: ___ + S + V → 접속사(before/after/when/while)

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (동사 수식) - carefully
explanation: 동사 'reviewed'를 수식하는 자리에는 부사 'carefully'가 필요하다. careful(형용사), carefulness(명사), caring(형용사)는 동사를 수식할 수 없다.
correctExample: The legal team carefully reviewed the terms of the new partnership agreement before presenting it to the board.
incorrectExample: The legal team careful reviewed the terms of the new partnership agreement before presenting it to the board.
tip: 주어 + ___ + 동사 → 부사

title: 대명사 - 재귀대명사 (주어=목적어)
explanation: 주어 'applicants'와 목적어가 동일 대상이므로 재귀대명사 'themselves'가 필요하다. them(목적격), their(소유격), they(주격)는 주어와 목적어가 같은 경우에 부적절하다.
correctExample: All applicants should familiarize themselves with the company policies before attending the final interview round.
incorrectExample: All applicants should familiarize them with the company policies before attending the final interview round.
tip: 주어 = 목적어 → 재귀대명사(-self/-selves)

title: 시제 - 현재완료 (already)
explanation: 'already'는 이미 완료된 동작을 나타내므로 현재완료 'has already been'을 사용한다. already was(과거), already is(현재), will already be(미래)는 already와의 조합이 부자연스럽다.
correctExample: The budget for the new marketing campaign has already been approved by the vice president of the sales division.
incorrectExample: The budget for the new marketing campaign already was approved by the vice president of the sales division.
tip: already/yet/just → have/has + p.p.
distractors: already was approved,already is approved,will already be approved

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (명사 수식) - experienced
explanation: 명사 'staff' 앞에서 수식하는 역할은 형용사 'experienced'가 한다. experience(명사/동사), experientially(부사), experiencing(동명사)은 명사 앞 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The hotel is known for its experienced staff who provide excellent customer service to all guests throughout their stay.
incorrectExample: The hotel is known for its experience staff who provide excellent customer service to all guests throughout their stay.
tip: 소유격/관사 + ___ + 명사 → 형용사

title: 전치사 - with (수단/동반)
explanation: '~을 가지고/~와 함께'라는 동반의 의미로 전치사 'with'를 사용한다. by(수단/방법), from(출처), through(경유)는 이 문맥에서 동반을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: All employees must comply with the updated safety regulations that were issued by the health and safety committee.
incorrectExample: All employees must comply by the updated safety regulations that were issued by the health and safety committee.
tip: comply + ___ → with (연어)

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (목적어)
explanation: 동사 'made' 뒤 목적어 자리에는 명사 'improvements'가 와야 한다. improve(동사), improved(형용사/과거분사), improvable(형용사)는 목적어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The IT department has made significant improvements to the network security system over the past several months.
incorrectExample: The IT department has made significant improve to the network security system over the past several months.
tip: 동사 + 형용사 + ___ → 명사(목적어)

title: 수동태 - 현재완료 수동
explanation: 주어 'The office building'이 리모델링되는 대상이고 'recently'가 있으므로 현재완료 수동태 'has been renovated'를 사용한다. has renovated(능동태)는 주어가 행위자가 아니므로 부적절하고, was renovating(과거 진행 능동)과 had renovated(과거완료 능동)도 수동 의미를 나타낼 수 없다.
correctExample: The office building on Main Street has been renovated recently to include modern workspaces and updated meeting rooms.
incorrectExample: The office building on Main Street has renovated recently to include modern workspaces and updated meeting rooms.
tip: 주어가 대상 + recently → has/have + been + p.p.

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (동사 수식) - promptly
explanation: 동사 'responded'를 수식하는 자리에는 부사 'promptly'가 필요하다. prompt(형용사), promptness(명사), prompting(동명사)은 동사를 수식할 수 없다.
correctExample: The customer service representative promptly responded to the client's inquiry about the delayed shipment of goods.
incorrectExample: The customer service representative prompt responded to the client's inquiry about the delayed shipment of goods.
tip: 주어 + ___ + 동사(과거) → 부사

title: 접속사 - if (조건)
explanation: 조건을 나타내는 절을 이끄는 접속사 'if'가 필요하다. whether(간접의문), unless(~하지 않는 한), in case(전치사구)는 이 문맥에서 단순 조건을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Customers will receive a full refund if the product is returned within thirty days of the original purchase date.
incorrectExample: Customers will receive a full refund whether the product is returned within thirty days of the original purchase date.
tip: 조건 → if + S + V

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (보어 - seem)
explanation: 연결동사 'seem' 뒤 보어 자리에는 형용사 'reasonable'이 와야 한다. reason(명사), reasonably(부사), reasoning(명사/동명사)은 보어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The proposed timeline for the construction project does not seem reasonable given the current shortage of building materials.
incorrectExample: The proposed timeline for the construction project does not seem reasonably given the current shortage of building materials.
tip: 연결동사(seem/appear/look) + ___ → 형용사

title: 전치사 - to (방향/목적)
explanation: 동사 'sent'와 함께 목적지를 나타내는 전치사 'to'를 사용한다. for(목적), at(장소), into(내부로)는 이 문맥에서 방향을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The shipping department sent the replacement parts to the customer's warehouse address within three business days.
incorrectExample: The shipping department sent the replacement parts for the customer's warehouse address within three business days.
tip: send/deliver/ship + ___ + 장소 → to

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (동격)
explanation: 동사 'ensure'의 목적어 자리에는 명사 'satisfaction'이 와야 한다. satisfy(동사), satisfactory(형용사), satisfactorily(부사)는 목적어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The hotel management team works hard to ensure customer satisfaction by addressing all complaints within twenty-four hours.
incorrectExample: The hotel management team works hard to ensure customer satisfy by addressing all complaints within twenty-four hours.
tip: 동사 + 명사(수식어) + ___ → 명사

title: 시제 - 미래 (be going to)
explanation: 'next quarter'라는 미래 시점이 있으므로 미래 표현 'is going to implement'를 사용한다. implemented(과거), implements(현재), has implemented(현재완료)는 미래 시점과 어울리지 않는다.
correctExample: The management team is going to implement a new flexible working policy starting from the beginning of next quarter.
incorrectExample: The management team implemented a new flexible working policy starting from the beginning of next quarter.
tip: next + 시간 → be going to + 동사원형 / will + 동사원형

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (형용사 수식) - highly
explanation: 형용사 'successful'을 수식하는 자리에는 부사 'highly'가 필요하다. high(형용사), height(명사), heighten(동사)은 형용사를 수식할 수 없다.
correctExample: The training program has been highly successful in improving employee productivity across all departments of the company.
incorrectExample: The training program has been high successful in improving employee productivity across all departments of the company.
tip: ___ + 형용사 → 부사(highly/extremely/remarkably)

title: 대명사 - 주격
explanation: 주어 자리에는 주격 대명사 'They'가 와야 한다. Them(목적격), Their(소유격), Themselves(재귀대명사)는 주어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: They are expected to finalize the merger agreement with the foreign partner company by the end of this fiscal year.
incorrectExample: Them are expected to finalize the merger agreement with the foreign partner company by the end of this fiscal year.
tip: ___ + 동사 → 주격 대명사(I/He/She/They/We)

title: 수 일치 - 단수 주어 + 단수 동사
explanation: 주어 'Each employee'는 단수이므로 단수 동사 'is required'를 사용한다. are required(복수), were required(과거 복수), have required(복수 현재완료)는 단수 주어와 맞지 않는다.
correctExample: Each employee is required to update their contact information in the human resources database before the end of March.
incorrectExample: Each employee are required to update their contact information in the human resources database before the end of March.
tip: Each/Every + 단수명사 → 단수 동사(is/has/V-s)

title: 어휘 - ensure vs insure
explanation: ensure는 '확실히 하다'라는 뜻으로 이 문맥에 적합하다. insure(보험을 들다), assure(확신시키다, 사람 목적어), endure(견디다)는 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: The quality control team must ensure that all products meet the international safety standards before shipment to retailers.
incorrectExample: The quality control team must insure that all products meet the international safety standards before shipment to retailers.
tip: ~을 확실히 하다 → ensure / 보험 → insure / 사람에게 확신 → assure

title: 전치사 vs 접속사 - despite vs although
explanation: 'the heavy rain'은 명사구이므로 전치사 'Despite'를 사용한다. Although(접속사, 뒤에 절), Because(접속사, 이유), Even though(접속사)는 뒤에 절이 필요하다.
correctExample: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor charity event attracted more than three hundred attendees from the local community.
incorrectExample: Although the heavy rain, the outdoor charity event attracted more than three hundred attendees from the local community.
tip: ___ + 명사(구) → 전치사(despite/due to/because of)

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (전치사 + ___ + of)
explanation: 전치사 뒤, of 앞에는 명사 'reduction'이 와야 한다. reduce(동사), reduced(과거분사), reductive(형용사)는 이 위치에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The company announced a significant reduction of operating costs through the implementation of automated manufacturing processes.
incorrectExample: The company announced a significant reduce of operating costs through the implementation of automated manufacturing processes.
tip: 형용사 + ___ + of → 명사

title: 어휘 - rise vs raise
explanation: rise는 자동사로 '오르다'의 뜻이다. raise(타동사, 올리다), arise(발생하다), rose(rise의 과거)는 이 문맥에서 문법적으로 맞지 않는다.
correctExample: Operating expenses are expected to rise significantly next year due to the increase in raw material prices worldwide.
incorrectExample: Operating expenses are expected to raise significantly next year due to the increase in raw material prices worldwide.
tip: 자동사(주어 스스로) → rise / 타동사(목적어 필요) → raise

title: 수 일치 - 복수 주어
explanation: 주어 'The members of the committee'에서 실질 주어는 복수 'members'이므로 복수 동사 'have agreed'를 사용한다. has agreed(단수), agrees(단수 현재), was agreed(단수 과거)는 복수 주어와 맞지 않는다.
correctExample: The members of the committee have agreed to postpone the decision until more detailed financial data becomes available.
incorrectExample: The members of the committee has agreed to postpone the decision until more detailed financial data becomes available.
tip: The members of ~ → 복수 주어 → have/are + V

title: 접속부사 - however
explanation: 앞 문장과 역접 관계이므로 접속부사 'However'가 필요하다. Therefore(결과), Moreover(추가), Furthermore(추가)는 역접 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: The initial sales projections were quite optimistic. However, the actual figures fell short of expectations by nearly twenty percent.
incorrectExample: The initial sales projections were quite optimistic. Therefore, the actual figures fell short of expectations by nearly twenty percent.
tip: 앞 문장과 반대 → However / 결과 → Therefore / 추가 → Moreover

title: 어휘 - affect vs effect
explanation: affect는 동사로 '영향을 미치다'의 뜻이다. effect(명사, 영향/결과), infect(감염시키다), defect(결함)는 이 문맥에서 부적절하다.
correctExample: The recent changes in trade regulations could significantly affect the profitability of our international business operations.
incorrectExample: The recent changes in trade regulations could significantly effect the profitability of our international business operations.
tip: 동사 자리 → affect(영향을 미치다) / 명사 자리 → effect(영향, 결과)

title: 전치사 - between (둘 사이)
explanation: 두 대상(the marketing department and the sales team) 사이를 나타내므로 'between'을 사용한다. among(셋 이상), within(내부), through(통과)는 두 대상 사이에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Better communication between the marketing department and the sales team has led to a notable increase in quarterly revenue.
incorrectExample: Better communication among the marketing department and the sales team has led to a notable increase in quarterly revenue.
tip: A and B 사이 → between / 셋 이상 → among

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (명사 수식) - financial
explanation: 명사 'decision' 앞에서 수식하는 자리에는 형용사 'financial'이 와야 한다. finance(명사), financially(부사), financing(동명사)는 명사 앞 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The board of directors will make the final financial decision after reviewing all the proposals submitted by each department.
incorrectExample: The board of directors will make the final financially decision after reviewing all the proposals submitted by each department.
tip: the + ___ + 명사 → 형용사

title: 어휘 - postpone vs cancel
explanation: postpone은 '연기하다'로 나중에 진행할 의도가 있다. cancel(취소하다), prevent(방지하다), suspend(일시 중단하다)는 이 문맥에서 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: The project team decided to postpone the product launch until the results of the final quality inspection are confirmed.
incorrectExample: The project team decided to cancel the product launch until the results of the final quality inspection are confirmed.
tip: 나중으로 미루다 → postpone / 완전 중지 → cancel / 잠시 멈추다 → suspend

title: 관계대명사 - who (주격)
explanation: 선행사 'candidates'가 사람이고 뒤에 동사가 오므로 주격 관계대명사 'who'가 필요하다. whom(목적격), which(사물), whose(소유격)는 주격 자리에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The company is looking for candidates who have strong communication skills and at least three years of management experience.
incorrectExample: The company is looking for candidates whom have strong communication skills and at least three years of management experience.
tip: 선행사(사람) + ___ + 동사 → who(주격)

title: 접속사 - so that (목적)
explanation: 목적을 나타내는 절을 이끄는 접속사 'so that'이 필요하다. in order to(전치사구, 뒤에 동사원형), for(전치사), because(이유)는 이 문맥에서 목적절을 이끌 수 없다.
correctExample: The company redesigned its website so that customers can more easily find information about products and services online.
incorrectExample: The company redesigned its website because customers can more easily find information about products and services online.
tip: 목적(~하도록) + S + V → so that

title: 전치사 - on behalf of (~을 대신하여)
explanation: '~을 대신하여'라는 뜻의 전치사구 'on behalf of'가 필요하다. in case of(~의 경우에), in terms of(~의 관점에서), in spite of(~에도 불구하고)는 이 문맥에서 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: Ms. Johnson will attend the international trade conference on behalf of the company's chief executive officer next week.
incorrectExample: Ms. Johnson will attend the international trade conference in case of the company's chief executive officer next week.
tip: ~을 대신하여 → on behalf of
distractors: in case of,in terms of,in spite of

title: 수 일치 - 불가산명사 + 단수 동사
explanation: 주어 'The equipment'는 불가산명사이므로 단수 동사 'needs'를 사용한다. need(복수/원형), have needed(복수 현재완료), are needing(복수 진행)은 불가산 단수 주어와 맞지 않는다.
correctExample: The equipment in the laboratory needs to be inspected regularly to ensure accurate test results for all research projects.
incorrectExample: The equipment in the laboratory need to be inspected regularly to ensure accurate test results for all research projects.
tip: 불가산명사(equipment/information/furniture) → 단수 동사

title: 어휘 - comply vs comply with
explanation: '규정을 준수하다'의 의미로 'comply with'를 사용한다. comply to(비표준), comply for(비표준), comply at(비표준)는 올바른 전치사 조합이 아니다.
correctExample: All manufacturing facilities are required to comply with the environmental regulations set by the local government authorities.
incorrectExample: All manufacturing facilities are required to comply to the environmental regulations set by the local government authorities.
tip: comply + with / conform + to / adhere + to

title: 시제 - 과거 진행형
explanation: 'when the fire alarm went off'라는 과거 시점에 진행 중이던 동작이므로 과거 진행형 'were discussing'을 사용한다. discussed(과거), discuss(현재), have discussed(현재완료)는 진행 중 동작을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The managers were discussing the annual budget plan when the fire alarm went off and everyone evacuated the building.
incorrectExample: The managers discussed the annual budget plan when the fire alarm went off and everyone evacuated the building.
tip: when + 과거 동작 → 주절은 was/were + V-ing(진행 중)

title: 어휘 - prospective vs perspective
explanation: prospective는 형용사로 '장래의, 예상되는'의 뜻이다. perspective(관점, 명사), respective(각각의), retrospective(회고적인)는 이 문맥에서 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: All prospective employees must complete a background check before they can begin working at the company headquarters.
incorrectExample: All perspective employees must complete a background check before they can begin working at the company headquarters.
tip: 장래의/예상되는 → prospective / 관점 → perspective

title: to부정사 vs 동명사 - decide to
explanation: decide는 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이다. expanding(동명사), expand(원형), expanded(과거)는 decide 뒤에 올 수 없다.
correctExample: The board of directors decided to expand its operations into the Southeast Asian market starting from the next fiscal year.
incorrectExample: The board of directors decided expanding its operations into the Southeast Asian market starting from the next fiscal year.
tip: decide/plan/agree/expect + to V

title: 관계대명사 - which (사물)
explanation: 선행사 'the proposal'이 사물이고 뒤에 동사가 오므로 주격 관계대명사 'which'가 필요하다. who(사람), whom(사람 목적격), whose(소유격)는 사물에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The proposal, which was submitted by the marketing department last week, has been approved by the senior management team.
incorrectExample: The proposal, who was submitted by the marketing department last week, has been approved by the senior management team.
tip: 선행사(사물) + ___ + 동사 → which

title: 어휘 - eligible vs illegible
explanation: eligible은 '자격이 있는'의 뜻이다. illegible(읽기 어려운), electable(선출 가능한), eliminable(제거 가능한)는 이 문맥에서 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: Employees who have worked at the company for more than one year are eligible for the annual performance bonus program.
incorrectExample: Employees who have worked at the company for more than one year are illegible for the annual performance bonus program.
tip: 자격이 있는 → eligible / 읽기 어려운 → illegible

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (동사 수식) - considerably
explanation: 동사 'exceeded'를 수식하는 자리에는 부사 'considerably'가 필요하다. considerable(형용사), consideration(명사), considerate(형용사)는 동사를 수식할 수 없다.
correctExample: The total sales revenue this quarter considerably exceeded the original forecast set by the financial planning department.
incorrectExample: The total sales revenue this quarter considerable exceeded the original forecast set by the financial planning department.
tip: 주어 + ___ + 동사 → 부사

title: 접속사 - while (동시)
explanation: '~하는 동안'이라는 동시 진행을 나타내며 뒤에 절이 오므로 접속사 'while'이 필요하다. during(전치사), meanwhile(접속부사), for(전치사)는 뒤에 절을 이끌 수 없다.
correctExample: Employees should keep their identification badges visible at all times while they are inside the company's secure facility.
incorrectExample: Employees should keep their identification badges visible at all times during they are inside the company's secure facility.
tip: ___ + S + V(절) → while / ___ + 명사(구) → during

title: 전치사 - according to (~에 따르면)
explanation: '~에 따르면, ~의 말에 의하면'이라는 뜻의 전치사구 'According to'가 정답이다. 'According with'는 문법적으로 틀린 표현이다—'according' 뒤에는 반드시 'to'가 와야 한다. Owing to(~때문에)는 이유를 나타내고, In addition to(~에 더하여)는 추가를 나타내므로 정보 출처를 인용하는 이 문맥과 의미가 전혀 다르다.
correctExample: According to the latest market research report, consumer spending on electronic devices increased by fifteen percent last year.
incorrectExample: According with the latest market research report, consumer spending on electronic devices increased by fifteen percent last year.
tip: 정보 출처 인용: According to + [출처]. 'According with'는 틀린 표현! 반드시 'According to'를 사용하세요.

title: to부정사 vs 동명사 - consider + V-ing
explanation: consider는 동명사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이다. to relocate(to부정사), relocate(원형), relocated(과거)는 consider 뒤에 올 수 없다.
correctExample: The company is considering relocating its headquarters to a larger office space in the downtown business district area.
incorrectExample: The company is considering to relocate its headquarters to a larger office space in the downtown business district area.
tip: consider/enjoy/avoid/suggest + V-ing(동명사)

title: 어휘 - substantial vs substantive
explanation: substantial은 '상당한, 실질적인'의 뜻이다. substantive(본질적인), substitute(대체의), subsequent(그 다음의)는 이 문맥에서 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: The merger between the two technology firms is expected to result in substantial cost savings over the next three years.
incorrectExample: The merger between the two technology firms is expected to result in substantive cost savings over the next three years.
tip: 상당한 양 → substantial / 본질적인 → substantive / 다음의 → subsequent

title: 관계대명사 - whose (소유격)
explanation: 선행사 'employees' 뒤에 소유 관계를 나타내므로 소유격 관계대명사 'whose'가 필요하다. who(주격), whom(목적격), which(사물)는 소유격 자리에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Employees whose performance ratings exceed the department average will be considered for promotion during the next review cycle.
incorrectExample: Employees who performance ratings exceed the department average will be considered for promotion during the next review cycle.
tip: 선행사 + ___ + 명사 → whose(소유격)

title: 수 일치 - neither A nor B
explanation: 'Neither A nor B' 구문에서 동사는 B에 일치시킨다. B가 'the vice president'(단수)이므로 단수 동사 'has confirmed'를 사용한다.
correctExample: Neither the department managers nor the vice president has confirmed the schedule for the annual strategy retreat yet.
incorrectExample: Neither the department managers nor the vice president have confirmed the schedule for the annual strategy retreat yet.
tip: Neither A nor B → B에 수 일치

title: 어휘 - revise vs review
explanation: revise는 '수정하다'라는 뜻으로 문서를 수정하는 이 문맥에 적합하다. review(검토하다), reverse(뒤집다), reveal(밝히다)는 수정의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: The legal team was asked to revise the contract terms to include additional clauses related to intellectual property rights.
incorrectExample: The legal team was asked to review the contract terms to include additional clauses related to intellectual property rights.
tip: 수정 → revise / 검토 → review / 밝히다 → reveal

title: 접속사 - once (~하면/~하자마자)
explanation: '~하면 곧'이라는 조건/시간의 접속사 'Once'가 필요하다. After(~한 후에), Since(~이래로), Until(~까지)는 이 문맥에서 즉시성을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Once the new software system is fully installed, the IT team will conduct training sessions for all department staff members.
incorrectExample: Since the new software system is fully installed, the IT team will conduct training sessions for all department staff members.
tip: ~하면 곧 → Once + S + V / ~한 후에 → After / ~까지 → Until

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (명사 수식) - operational
explanation: 명사 'procedures' 앞에서 수식하는 자리에는 형용사 'operational'이 와야 한다. operate(동사), operationally(부사), operation(명사)는 명사 앞 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The audit team identified several operational procedures that need to be updated to comply with the new industry standards.
incorrectExample: The audit team identified several operation procedures that need to be updated to comply with the new industry standards.
tip: several + ___ + 명사(복수) → 형용사

title: 어휘 - thorough vs through
explanation: thorough는 형용사로 '철저한'의 뜻이다. through(전치사, ~을 통해), though(접속사, ~이지만), throughout(전치사, ~내내)는 형용사 자리에 올 수 없다.
correctExample: A thorough investigation into the accounting discrepancies was conducted by the external audit firm last quarter.
incorrectExample: A through investigation into the accounting discrepancies was conducted by the external audit firm last quarter.
tip: 형용사(철저한) → thorough / 전치사(통해) → through / 접속사(~이지만) → though

title: 전치사 - regarding (~에 관하여)
explanation: '~에 관하여'라는 뜻의 전치사 'regarding'이 필요하다. regarded(동사 과거), regardless(부사), regard(명사/동사)는 전치사 역할을 할 수 없다.
correctExample: If you have any concerns regarding the new employee health insurance plan, please contact the benefits coordinator directly.
incorrectExample: If you have any concerns regardless the new employee health insurance plan, please contact the benefits coordinator directly.
tip: ~에 관하여 → regarding/concerning/about

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (make + ___ + to V)
explanation: make a commitment(결심하다)에서 명사 'commitment'이 필요하다. commit(동사), committed(형용사), committing(동명사)은 이 구조에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The CEO made a strong commitment to improving workplace diversity and inclusion across all levels of the organization.
incorrectExample: The CEO made a strong commit to improving workplace diversity and inclusion across all levels of the organization.
tip: make a + ___ → 명사(commitment/decision/contribution)

title: 시제 - 현재완료 진행형
explanation: 'for the past three months'라는 기간이 현재까지 계속되므로 현재완료 진행형 'has been working'을 사용한다. worked(과거), is working(현재 진행), had worked(과거완료)는 과거부터 현재까지의 계속을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The development team has been working on the mobile application update for the past three months to meet the deadline.
incorrectExample: The development team worked on the mobile application update for the past three months to meet the deadline.
tip: for the past + 기간 → have/has + been + V-ing(현재완료 진행)

title: 어휘 - adjacent vs adjust
explanation: adjacent는 '인접한'의 뜻으로 건물 위치를 설명하는 이 문맥에 적합하다. adjust(조정하다), adequate(적절한), adopted(채택된)는 이 문맥에서 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: The new parking garage is adjacent to the main office building and can accommodate up to five hundred vehicles at once.
incorrectExample: The new parking garage is adjust to the main office building and can accommodate up to five hundred vehicles at once.
tip: 인접한 → adjacent / 조정하다 → adjust / 적절한 → adequate

title: 접속사 - as long as (조건)
explanation: '~하는 한'이라는 조건의 접속사 'as long as'가 필요하다. as far as(~하는 한, 범위), as well as(~뿐만 아니라), as soon as(~하자마자)는 이 문맥에서 조건을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Employees may work remotely as long as they meet all the project deadlines and attend mandatory weekly team meetings.
incorrectExample: Employees may work remotely as soon as they meet all the project deadlines and attend mandatory weekly team meetings.
tip: 조건(~하는 한) → as long as / 즉시(~하자마자) → as soon as
distractors: as soon as,as far as,as well as

title: 수 일치 - a number of + 복수동사
explanation: 'A number of complaints'에서 실질 주어는 복수 'complaints'이므로 복수 동사 'have been'을 사용한다. has been(단수), was(단수 과거), is(단수 현재)는 복수 주어와 맞지 않는다.
correctExample: A number of complaints have been received about the noise from the construction site near the residential apartment complex.
incorrectExample: A number of complaints has been received about the noise from the construction site near the residential apartment complex.
tip: A number of + 복수명사 → 복수 동사 / The number of + 복수명사 → 단수 동사

title: 어휘 - reimburse vs compensate
explanation: reimburse는 '직원이 업무상 선불로 지출한 경비를 돌려주다'라는 의미의 비즈니스 고정 어휘이다. repay(빌린 돈/채무를 갚다)는 대출 상환 문맥에, refund(환불하다)는 소비자가 구매 상품을 반품할 때, compensate(보상하다)는 손해·부상에 대한 배상 맥락에 각각 특화된 단어로, 직원 경비 환급 상황에서는 reimburse가 유일하게 적절하다.
correctExample: The company will reimburse employees for all reasonable travel expenses incurred during approved business trips abroad.
incorrectExample: The company will repay employees for all reasonable travel expenses incurred during approved business trips abroad.
tip: 직원 업무 경비 환급 → reimburse for expenses. compensate = 손해 배상, refund = 상품 환불, repay = 채무 상환 — 문맥에 따라 명확히 구분하세요!

title: to부정사 vs 동명사 - recommend + V-ing
explanation: recommend는 동명사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이다. to install(to부정사), install(원형), installed(과거)는 recommend 뒤에 올 수 없다.
correctExample: The IT security advisor recommended installing the latest antivirus software on all company computers to prevent data breaches.
incorrectExample: The IT security advisor recommended to install the latest antivirus software on all company computers to prevent data breaches.
tip: recommend/suggest/advise + V-ing(동명사)

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (전체 문장 수식)
explanation: 문장 전체를 수식하는 자리에는 부사 'Consequently'가 와야 한다. Consequent(형용사), Consequence(명사), Consequential(형용사)는 문장 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: Consequently, the company decided to hire additional temporary staff to handle the increased volume of customer orders.
incorrectExample: Consequent, the company decided to hire additional temporary staff to handle the increased volume of customer orders.
tip: ___,  + 완전한 문장 → 접속부사(Consequently/Therefore/However)

title: 전치사 - in addition to (~에 더하여)
explanation: '~에 더하여'라는 뜻의 전치사구 'In addition to'가 필요하다. Moreover(접속부사), Furthermore(접속부사)는 뒤에 명사구를 직접 이끌 수 없고, As opposed to(~와 대조적으로)는 의미가 맞지 않는다.
correctExample: In addition to the base salary, the company offers comprehensive health insurance and a generous retirement savings plan.
incorrectExample: Moreover the base salary, the company offers comprehensive health insurance and a generous retirement savings plan.
tip: ___ + 명사(구) → In addition to / Besides

title: 어휘 - implement vs imply
explanation: implement는 '실행하다, 시행하다'의 뜻으로 정책 시행 문맥에 적합하다. imply(암시하다), impose(부과하다), import(수입하다)는 이 문맥에서 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: The management team plans to implement a new performance evaluation system by the beginning of the next fiscal year.
incorrectExample: The management team plans to imply a new performance evaluation system by the beginning of the next fiscal year.
tip: 시행하다 → implement / 암시하다 → imply / 부과하다 → impose

title: 관계대명사 - whom (목적격)
explanation: 선행사 'the candidate'가 사람이고 관계절 안에서 목적어 역할이므로 목적격 관계대명사 'whom'이 필요하다. who(주격), which(사물), whose(소유격)는 목적격 자리에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The candidate whom the hiring committee selected for the position has over ten years of experience in financial consulting.
incorrectExample: The candidate who the hiring committee selected for the position has over ten years of experience in financial consulting.
tip: 선행사(사람) + ___ + S + V → whom(목적격)

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (전치사 뒤)
explanation: 전치사 'without' 뒤에는 명사 'approval'이 와야 한다. approve(동사), approved(과거분사), approvingly(부사)는 전치사 뒤에 올 수 없다.
correctExample: No major purchases can be made without approval from the department head and the finance division chief officer.
incorrectExample: No major purchases can be made without approve from the department head and the finance division chief officer.
tip: 전치사(without/with/for) + ___ → 명사

title: 어휘 - approximate vs appropriate
explanation: approximate는 '대략적인'의 뜻으로 정확하지 않은 추정치를 나타낸다. appropriate(적절한), appreciative(감사하는), applicable(적용 가능한)는 이 문맥에서 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: Since the final figures were not yet available, the project manager provided only an approximate cost estimate for the renovation.
incorrectExample: Since the final figures were not yet available, the project manager provided only an appropriate cost estimate for the renovation.
tip: 대략적인 → approximate / 적절한 → appropriate / 적용 가능한 → applicable

title: 시제 - will be + V-ing (미래 진행)
explanation: 'at this time tomorrow'라는 미래 특정 시점에서의 진행을 나타내므로 미래 진행형 'will be conducting'을 사용한다.
correctExample: At this time tomorrow, the quality assurance team will be conducting the final product testing before the scheduled launch.
incorrectExample: At this time tomorrow, the quality assurance team conducts the final product testing before the scheduled launch.
tip: at this time tomorrow/next week → will be + V-ing(미래 진행)

title: 접속사 - unless (~하지 않는 한)
explanation: '~하지 않는 한'이라는 부정 조건의 접속사 'unless'가 필요하다. if not(구어체), except(전치사), without(전치사)는 접속사로 절을 이끌 수 없다.
correctExample: The outdoor event will proceed as planned unless the weather forecast indicates heavy rainfall or severe thunderstorms.
incorrectExample: The outdoor event will proceed as planned without the weather forecast indicates heavy rainfall or severe thunderstorms.
tip: ~하지 않는 한 + S + V → unless

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (보어 - find + O + C)
explanation: find + 목적어 + 보어 구조에서 보어 자리에는 형용사 'helpful'이 와야 한다. help(동사/명사), helpfully(부사), helpfulness(명사)는 보어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: Many participants found the workshop sessions extremely helpful in developing new strategies for customer relationship management.
incorrectExample: Many participants found the workshop sessions extremely helpfulness in developing new strategies for customer relationship management.
tip: find + O + ___ → 형용사(보어)

title: 전치사 - prior to (~에 앞서)
explanation: '~에 앞서'라는 뜻의 전치사구 'prior to'가 필요하다. before(접속사/전치사), ahead(부사), previously(부사)는 이 문맥에서 뒤에 동명사를 자연스럽게 이끌 수 없거나 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: All participants must register online prior to attending the annual industry conference held at the convention center.
incorrectExample: All participants must register online previously attending the annual industry conference held at the convention center.
tip: ___ + V-ing/명사 → prior to / before

title: 시제 - 과거완료
explanation: 종속절의 시점(보고서 발표 이전)이 주절(stated)보다 더 앞선 과거이므로 과거완료(had + p.p.)를 사용한다. have/has는 현재완료로 과거 기준점 없음, will have는 미래완료로 불가.
correctExample: The finance director stated that the figures had been verified before the report was released to shareholders last Friday.
incorrectExample: The finance director stated that the figures have been verified before the report was released to shareholders last Friday.
tip: stated(과거) + before + 과거 → 더 앞선 시점 = had + p.p.
distractors: have been verified,has been verified,will have been verified

title: 분사 - 현재분사 vs 과거분사 (감정)
explanation: 주어 'The results'가 감정을 유발하는 원인이므로 현재분사 'disappointing'을 사용한다. disappointed(감정을 느끼는 주체), disappoint(동사원형), disappointment(명사)는 이 문맥에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The results of the customer satisfaction survey were quite disappointing and prompted the management to revise the service policy.
incorrectExample: The results of the customer satisfaction survey were quite disappointed and prompted the management to revise the service policy.
tip: 사물/원인 → -ing(현재분사) / 사람/감정 느끼는 주체 → -ed(과거분사)

title: 어휘 - stringent vs strict
explanation: stringent는 '엄격한(규제/기준)'의 뜻으로 공식적 규제 문맥에 적합하다. strict(엄격한, 일상적), strenuous(격렬한), strategic(전략적인)는 규제 문맥에서 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The pharmaceutical company must adhere to stringent quality control measures to obtain approval from the regulatory authorities.
incorrectExample: The pharmaceutical company must adhere to strenuous quality control measures to obtain approval from the regulatory authorities.
tip: 규제/기준이 엄격한 → stringent / 격렬한 → strenuous / 전략적 → strategic

title: 관계부사 - where (장소)
explanation: 선행사 'the facility'가 장소이고 관계절에서 부사 역할이므로 관계부사 'where'가 필요하다. which(주격/목적격), that(주격/목적격), when(시간)은 장소 부사 역할에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The company opened a new research facility where scientists can conduct experiments using state-of-the-art laboratory equipment.
incorrectExample: The company opened a new research facility which scientists can conduct experiments using state-of-the-art laboratory equipment.
tip: 선행사(장소) + ___ + 완전한 절 → where

title: 가정법 과거 - 현재 사실 반대
explanation: 현재 사실의 반대를 가정하므로 'If + 주어 + 과거동사(were)' 구조를 사용한다. is(현재), will be(미래), has been(현재완료)은 가정법이 아닌 직설법이다.
correctExample: If the budget allocation were larger, the company could invest more in advanced technology and employee development programs.
incorrectExample: If the budget allocation is larger, the company could invest more in advanced technology and employee development programs.
tip: 현재 사실 반대 → If + S + were/V-ed, S + would/could + V

title: 분사구문 - 현재분사 (동시동작)
explanation: 두 동작이 동시에 일어나므로 현재분사 'Recognizing'을 사용한 분사구문이 적절하다. Recognized(과거분사), To recognize(to부정사), Recognition(명사)은 동시동작의 분사구문으로 부적절하다.
correctExample: Recognizing the need for improved efficiency, the operations manager proposed a complete overhaul of the production workflow.
incorrectExample: Recognized the need for improved efficiency, the operations manager proposed a complete overhaul of the production workflow.
tip: 주어가 능동 + 동시동작 → V-ing(현재분사구문)

title: 어휘 - expedite vs accelerate
explanation: expedite는 '(절차/과정을) 신속히 처리하다'의 뜻으로 비즈니스 문맥에 적합하다. accelerate(속도를 높이다, 물리적), facilitate(용이하게 하다), elaborate(상세히 설명하다)는 절차 신속 처리의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: To expedite the approval process, all required documents should be submitted together with the completed application form.
incorrectExample: To accelerate the approval process, all required documents should be submitted together with the completed application form.
tip: 절차/과정 신속 처리 → expedite / 속도 높이다 → accelerate / 용이하게 → facilitate

title: 시제 - 미래완료
explanation: 'by the end of this year'라는 미래 기한까지의 완료를 나타내므로 미래완료 'will have completed'를 사용한다. completed(과거), has completed(현재완료), completes(현재)는 미래 기한과 어울리지 않는다.
correctExample: By the end of this year, the construction company will have completed the renovation of all three office buildings in the complex.
incorrectExample: By the end of this year, the construction company completed the renovation of all three office buildings in the complex.
tip: by + 미래시점 → will have + p.p.(미래완료)

title: 도치 - Not only ~ but also
explanation: 'Not only'가 문두에 오면 도치가 일어나 '조동사 + 주어 + 동사원형' 어순이 된다. 'did the company reduce'가 올바른 도치 형태이다. 'the company reduced'(평서문 어순), 'the company did reduce'(강조 구문), 'the company has reduced'(현재완료 평서문)는 도치 구문이 아니다.
correctExample: Not only did the company reduce operating costs, but it also significantly improved the quality of its customer service.
incorrectExample: Not only the company reduced operating costs, but it also significantly improved the quality of its customer service.
tip: Not only + 조동사 + S + V → 도치 구문
distractors: the company reduced,the company did reduce,the company has reduced

title: 어휘 - preliminary vs previous
explanation: preliminary는 '예비의, 사전의'라는 뜻으로 본격적인 검토 전 단계를 나타낸다. previous(이전의), primary(주요한), primitive(원시적인)는 예비 단계의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: The preliminary results of the market analysis suggest that there is strong consumer demand for eco-friendly packaging solutions.
incorrectExample: The previous results of the market analysis suggest that there is strong consumer demand for eco-friendly packaging solutions.
tip: 예비의/사전의 → preliminary / 이전의 → previous / 주요한 → primary

title: 분사 - 과거분사 (수동 의미)
explanation: 명사 'guidelines'가 '발행된' 대상이므로 과거분사 'issued'를 사용한다. issuing(현재분사, 능동), issue(동사원형), issuance(명사)는 수동 의미를 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: All employees must follow the revised guidelines issued by the compliance department regarding data privacy and security protocols.
incorrectExample: All employees must follow the revised guidelines issuing by the compliance department regarding data privacy and security protocols.
tip: 명사 + ___ + by → 과거분사(수동) / 명사가 능동 행위 → 현재분사

title: 연어 - closely monitor
explanation: '면밀히 감시하다'라는 연어 'closely monitor'가 정답이다. nearly(거의, 정도 부사)는 monitor와 연어를 이루지 않으며, tightly(단단히, 물리적 결속)는 모니터링 동작을 수식하기 부적절하다. broadly(광범위하게)는 monitor의 '세밀하고 집중적인 감시' 의미와 반대되어 연어 관계가 성립하지 않는다. 'closely monitor'는 프로젝트 진행 상황이나 시장 변화를 '주의 깊게 지켜보다'라는 TOEIC 필수 연어이다.
correctExample: The project supervisors are expected to closely monitor the progress of each phase to prevent potential delays in delivery.
incorrectExample: The project supervisors are expected to nearly monitor the progress of each phase to prevent potential delays in delivery.
tip: closely + monitor/examine/observe (면밀히 ~하다)

title: 품사 - 복합형용사 (명사 수식)
explanation: 명사 'equipment' 앞에서 수식하는 역할은 형용사 'state-of-the-art'가 한다. state(명사), stated(동사 과거), stating(동명사)은 명사 앞 수식어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The new manufacturing plant is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment designed to increase production capacity by thirty percent.
incorrectExample: The new manufacturing plant is equipped with state equipment designed to increase production capacity by thirty percent.
tip: 최신식의 → state-of-the-art / 비용 효율적인 → cost-effective

title: 시제 - 과거완료 진행형
explanation: 과거 특정 시점까지 계속 진행되던 동작을 나타내므로 과거완료 진행형 'had been negotiating'을 사용한다. were negotiating(과거 진행), negotiated(과거), have been negotiating(현재완료 진행)은 과거 기준점 이전의 진행을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The two companies had been negotiating the terms of the merger for six months before they finally reached an agreement.
incorrectExample: The two companies were negotiating the terms of the merger for six months before they finally reached an agreement.
tip: for + 기간 + before + 과거 → had been + V-ing(과거완료 진행)

title: 어휘 - alleviate vs eliminate
explanation: alleviate는 '(문제/고통을) 완화하다'의 뜻이다. eliminate(제거하다), elevate(높이다), allocate(배분하다)는 완화의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: The company introduced flexible working hours to alleviate the stress experienced by employees during peak business periods.
incorrectExample: The company introduced flexible working hours to eliminate the stress experienced by employees during peak business periods.
tip: 완화하다 → alleviate / 제거하다 → eliminate / 높이다 → elevate / 배분하다 → allocate

title: 수동태 - 현재완료 수동 + 분사
explanation: 주어 'measures'가 취해진 대상이므로 현재완료 수동태 'have been taken'을 사용한다. have taken(능동), took(과거 능동), were being taken(과거진행 수동)은 현재까지의 결과를 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Several measures have been taken to ensure that the company's data security system meets the latest international standards.
incorrectExample: Several measures have taken to ensure that the company's data security system meets the latest international standards.
tip: 주어(대상) + have/has + been + p.p. = 현재완료 수동

title: 연어 - meet the deadline
explanation: '마감을 지키다'라는 연어 'meet the deadline'이 필요하다. reach(도달하다), catch(잡다), achieve(달성하다)는 deadline과 자연스러운 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: The project team worked overtime every day last week to meet the deadline for the submission of the government contract proposal.
incorrectExample: The project team worked overtime every day last week to reach the deadline for the submission of the government contract proposal.
tip: 마감 지키다 → meet the deadline / 기대에 부응 → meet expectations

title: 관계대명사 - 전치사 + which
explanation: 전치사 'in'과 결합하여 관계절을 이끄는 'which'가 필요하다. that(전치사 뒤에 불가), where(관계부사), whom(사람)은 전치사 뒤에서 사물 선행사에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The conference room in which the board meeting was held has been renovated to accommodate up to fifty people comfortably.
incorrectExample: The conference room in that the board meeting was held has been renovated to accommodate up to fifty people comfortably.
tip: 전치사 + ___ (사물) → which (that 불가)

title: 어휘 - scrutinize vs examine
explanation: scrutinize는 '매우 면밀하고 비판적으로 조사하다'라는 강도 높은 조사 동사로, 감사(audit) 문맥에 가장 적합하다. examine(일반적으로 조사하다)은 의미는 유사하지만 세밀함과 비판적 시각이 부족하고, observe(관찰하다)는 수동적 관찰로 능동적 조사와 다르며, overlook(간과하다, 못 보고 지나치다)은 반대 의미여서 오답이다.
correctExample: The external auditors will scrutinize all financial transactions from the past fiscal year to identify any accounting irregularities.
incorrectExample: The external auditors will examine all financial transactions from the past fiscal year to identify any accounting irregularities.
tip: 감사(audit) 문맥 → scrutinize (가장 강도 높은 조사). examine(일반 조사) < scrutinize(면밀 검토) — 강도 차이를 기억하세요!

title: 접속사 - whereas (대조)
explanation: 앞뒤 절이 대조 관계이므로 접속사 'whereas'가 필요하다. therefore(결과), meanwhile(동시), besides(게다가)는 대조를 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The sales team exceeded its quarterly targets, whereas the marketing department fell significantly short of its projected goals.
incorrectExample: The sales team exceeded its quarterly targets, therefore the marketing department fell significantly short of its projected goals.
tip: 대조(A 반면 B) → whereas/while / 결과 → therefore

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (문장 수식)
explanation: '이에 따라/결과적으로'라는 의미로 문장을 수식하는 부사 'Accordingly'가 필요하다. Accord(명사/동사), Accordance(명사), According(형용사/전치사)은 문장 수식 부사로 부적절하다.
correctExample: The demand for organic products has increased dramatically. Accordingly, the company has expanded its organic product range.
incorrectExample: The demand for organic products has increased dramatically. Accordance, the company has expanded its organic product range.
tip: 결과/이에 따라 + 문장 → Accordingly/Therefore/Consequently

title: 연어 - reach a consensus
explanation: '합의에 도달하다'라는 연어 'reach a consensus'가 필요하다. take(취하다), make(만들다), get(얻다)는 consensus와 자연스러운 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: After extensive deliberation, the committee members were finally able to reach a consensus on the proposed budget allocation plan.
incorrectExample: After extensive deliberation, the committee members were finally able to take a consensus on the proposed budget allocation plan.
tip: 합의 도달 → reach a consensus / 결론 도달 → reach a conclusion

title: 가정법 과거완료 - 과거 사실 반대
explanation: 과거 사실의 반대를 가정하므로 'If + 주어 + had p.p.' 구조를 사용한다. invested(과거), has invested(현재완료), would invest(조건절 미래)는 과거 사실 반대의 가정법에 부적절하다.
correctExample: If the company had invested in renewable energy earlier, it would have saved millions of dollars in operating costs by now.
incorrectExample: If the company invested in renewable energy earlier, it would have saved millions of dollars in operating costs by now.
tip: 과거 사실 반대 → If + S + had p.p., S + would have + p.p.

title: 어휘 - compliance vs compliment
explanation: compliance는 '(규정) 준수'의 뜻으로 규정 준수 문맥에 적합하다. compliment(칭찬), complement(보완물), competence(능력)는 규정 준수의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: The company places great emphasis on compliance with all applicable industry regulations and government environmental standards.
incorrectExample: The company places great emphasis on compliment with all applicable industry regulations and government environmental standards.
tip: 규정 준수 → compliance / 칭찬 → compliment / 보완 → complement

title: 분사구문 - 과거분사 (수동)
explanation: 주어가 '검사된' 대상이므로 과거분사 'Inspected'를 사용한 분사구문이 적절하다. Inspecting(능동), Having inspect(문법 오류), To inspect(to부정사)는 수동 분사구문으로 부적절하다.
correctExample: Inspected by certified engineers, the newly constructed bridge was declared safe for public use by the city transportation department.
incorrectExample: Inspecting by certified engineers, the newly constructed bridge was declared safe for public use by the city transportation department.
tip: 주어가 수동 대상 → 과거분사(p.p.) + by ~

title: 연어 - take measures
explanation: '조치를 취하다'라는 연어 'take measures'가 필요하다. do(하다), have(가지다), give(주다)는 measures와 자연스러운 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: The management decided to take immediate measures to address the security vulnerabilities identified during the recent IT audit.
incorrectExample: The management decided to do immediate measures to address the security vulnerabilities identified during the recent IT audit.
tip: 조치를 취하다 → take measures/steps/action

title: 시제 - 현재완료 vs 과거 (경험)
explanation: 경험을 나타내므로 현재완료 'has consistently demonstrated'를 사용한다. consistently demonstrated(과거), consistently demonstrates(현재), will consistently demonstrate(미래)는 과거부터 현재까지의 경험을 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Throughout her career, Ms. Rivera has consistently demonstrated exceptional leadership skills in managing cross-functional project teams.
incorrectExample: Throughout her career, Ms. Rivera consistently demonstrated exceptional leadership skills in managing cross-functional project teams.
tip: Throughout/Over + 기간 → have/has + p.p.(경험/계속)

title: 어휘 - mitigate vs alleviate
explanation: mitigate는 '(위험/피해를) 완화하다'의 뜻으로 리스크 관리 문맥에 적합하다. alleviate(고통 완화), eliminate(제거), aggregate(집계하다)는 리스크 완화의 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The risk management team has developed new strategies to mitigate the potential impact of supply chain disruptions on production.
incorrectExample: The risk management team has developed new strategies to aggregate the potential impact of supply chain disruptions on production.
tip: 위험/피해 완화 → mitigate / 고통 완화 → alleviate / 제거 → eliminate

title: 관계대명사 - what (선행사 포함)
explanation: '~하는 것'이라는 의미로 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사 'what'이 필요하다. that(선행사 필요), which(선행사 필요), how(방법)는 선행사 없이 명사절을 이끌기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The marketing survey revealed what customers truly value when choosing between competing brands in the electronics market.
incorrectExample: The marketing survey revealed that customers truly value when choosing between competing brands in the electronics market.
tip: 동사 + ___ + S + V (명사절, 선행사 없음) → what(= the thing which)

title: 접속사 - provided that (조건)
explanation: '~라는 조건 하에'라는 의미의 접속사 'provided that'이 필요하다. unless(~하지 않는 한), in case(~의 경우에), so that(~하도록)는 조건부 승인의 의미에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The board will approve the expansion plan provided that the projected return on investment exceeds fifteen percent annually.
incorrectExample: The board will approve the expansion plan unless the projected return on investment exceeds fifteen percent annually.
tip: ~라는 조건 하에 → provided that / assuming that

title: 어휘 - unprecedented vs unparalleled
explanation: unprecedented는 '전례 없는'의 뜻으로 이전에 없었던 성장을 나타낸다. unparalleled(비할 데 없는), unexpected(예상치 못한), unrelated(관련 없는)는 전례 없음의 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: The technology sector experienced unprecedented growth last year driven by the rapid adoption of artificial intelligence solutions.
incorrectExample: The technology sector experienced unexpected growth last year driven by the rapid adoption of artificial intelligence solutions.
tip: 전례 없는 → unprecedented / 비할 데 없는 → unparalleled / 예상치 못한 → unexpected

title: 품사 - 형용사 자리 (수동의미 분사)
explanation: 명사 'report' 앞에서 '상세한'이라는 의미로 과거분사형 형용사 'detailed'가 필요하다. detail(명사/동사), detailing(현재분사), details(명사 복수)는 명사 수식에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The consultant submitted a detailed report outlining the recommended changes to the company's organizational structure and workflow.
incorrectExample: The consultant submitted a detail report outlining the recommended changes to the company's organizational structure and workflow.
tip: a + ___ + report/analysis → detailed/comprehensive/thorough

title: 연어 - bear in mind
explanation: '명심하다/염두에 두다'라는 연어 'bear in mind'가 필요하다. keep in mind(유사하지만 선택지에 없음), hold(잡다), place(놓다)는 이 연어에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Employees should bear in mind that all confidential client information must be stored in encrypted files on secure servers.
incorrectExample: Employees should hold in mind that all confidential client information must be stored in encrypted files on secure servers.
tip: 명심하다 → bear in mind / keep in mind

title: 시제 - 시간/조건 부사절 현재시제
explanation: 시간 부사절(when절)에서는 미래 대신 현재시제를 사용한다. 'arrives'가 올바르다. will arrive(미래), would arrive(조건), has arrived(완료)는 시간 부사절에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The receptionist will direct the visitors to the meeting room when the delegation arrives at the office building tomorrow.
incorrectExample: The receptionist will direct the visitors to the meeting room when the delegation will arrive at the office building tomorrow.
tip: when/if/before/after + S + 현재시제 (미래 대신)

title: 어휘 - tentative vs temporary
explanation: tentative는 '잠정적인/확정되지 않은'의 뜻이다. temporary(일시적인), extensive(광범위한), consecutive(연속적인)는 잠정적의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: The committee has released a tentative schedule for the annual conference, which is still subject to changes based on speaker availability.
incorrectExample: The committee has released a temporary schedule for the annual conference, which is still subject to changes based on speaker availability.
tip: 잠정적인/확정 아닌 → tentative / 일시적인 → temporary / 광범위한 → extensive

title: 수동태 - 감정 동사 수동 (be impressed)
explanation: 주어 'The investors'가 감정을 느끼는 사람이므로 과거분사 'impressed'를 사용한 수동형이 적절하다. impressing(현재분사), impressive(형용사), impression(명사)는 감정 경험 주체에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The investors were particularly impressed by the startup's innovative approach to solving complex supply chain management problems.
incorrectExample: The investors were particularly impressing by the startup's innovative approach to solving complex supply chain management problems.
tip: 사람(감정 주체) + be + p.p.(impressed/satisfied/concerned)

title: 접속사 - in the event that (~하는 경우에)
explanation: '~하는 경우에'라는 조건의 접속사구 'in the event that'이 필요하다. in case of(전치사구), despite(양보 전치사), as a result of(결과 전치사)는 조건절을 이끌 수 없다.
correctExample: In the event that the main server fails, all data will automatically be backed up to the secondary cloud storage system.
incorrectExample: In case of the main server fails, all data will automatically be backed up to the secondary cloud storage system.
tip: ___ + S + V(절) → in the event that / ___ + 명사 → in case of
distractors: In case of,Despite,As a result of

title: 어휘 - viable vs valuable
explanation: viable은 '실현 가능한'의 뜻으로 대안의 실현 가능성을 나타낸다. valuable(가치 있는), visible(보이는), variable(변동 가능한)는 실현 가능의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: After evaluating several options, the team concluded that outsourcing was the most viable alternative to reduce production costs.
incorrectExample: After evaluating several options, the team concluded that outsourcing was the most valuable alternative to reduce production costs.
tip: 실현 가능한 → viable / 가치 있는 → valuable / 보이는 → visible

title: 품사 - 명사 자리 (주어, 복합명사)
explanation: '고객 유지'라는 의미의 명사 'retention'이 주어 자리에 필요하다. retain(동사), retentive(형용사), retentively(부사)는 주어로 부적절하다.
correctExample: Customer retention has become a top priority for the company following the recent decline in subscriber renewal rates.
incorrectExample: Customer retain has become a top priority for the company following the recent decline in subscriber renewal rates.
tip: Customer/Employee + ___ → 명사(retention/satisfaction/engagement)

title: 연어 - address concerns
explanation: '우려를 해소하다'라는 연어 'address concerns'가 필요하다. answer(대답하다), solve(해결하다), respond(대응하다)는 concerns와 자연스러운 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: The management held an open forum to address concerns raised by employees about the proposed changes to the benefit plan.
incorrectExample: The management held an open forum to solve concerns raised by employees about the proposed changes to the benefit plan.
tip: 우려 해소 → address concerns / 불만 제기 → raise concerns

title: 시제 - 현재완료 (결과)
explanation: 과거 동작의 현재 결과를 나타내므로 현재완료 'has significantly reduced'를 사용한다. significantly reduced(과거), significantly reduces(현재), will significantly reduce(미래)는 과거 동작의 현재 결과를 나타내기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The implementation of the new inventory system has significantly reduced the number of shipping errors reported by our clients.
incorrectExample: The implementation of the new inventory system significantly reduced the number of shipping errors reported by our clients.
tip: 과거 동작 → 현재 결과 = have/has + p.p.

title: 어휘 - attain vs obtain
explanation: attain은 '(목표를) 달성하다'의 뜻으로 목표 달성 문맥에 적합하다. obtain(얻다, 구하다), retain(유지하다), contain(포함하다)는 목표 달성의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: The sales division managed to attain its annual revenue target despite the challenging economic conditions in the global market.
incorrectExample: The sales division managed to obtain its annual revenue target despite the challenging economic conditions in the global market.
tip: 목표 달성 → attain/achieve / 물건 획득 → obtain / 유지 → retain

title: 가정법 - 제안동사 + that + 원형
explanation: 제안동사 'recommended' 뒤의 that절에서는 동사원형 'be'를 사용한다. is(현재), was(과거), would be(조건)는 제안동사 뒤 that절에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The committee recommended that the new safety policy be implemented across all departments by the start of next quarter.
incorrectExample: The committee recommended that the new safety policy is implemented across all departments by the start of next quarter.
tip: recommend/suggest/insist/require + that + S + 동사원형

title: 접속사 - not only A but also B
explanation: 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'라는 의미의 상관접속사 'but also'가 필요하다. and also(단순 연결), but even(강조), as well(부사)는 not only와 짝을 이루기에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The new policy will not only reduce operational costs but also improve the overall efficiency of the manufacturing process.
incorrectExample: The new policy will not only reduce operational costs and also improve the overall efficiency of the manufacturing process.
tip: not only A + ___ + B → but also

title: 어휘 - fluctuate vs vary
explanation: fluctuate는 '(가격/수치가) 변동하다'의 뜻으로 환율 변동 문맥에 적합하다. vary(다양하다), alternate(교대하다), deviate(벗어나다)는 가격 변동의 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: Currency exchange rates tend to fluctuate significantly during periods of political instability and global economic uncertainty.
incorrectExample: Currency exchange rates tend to vary significantly during periods of political instability and global economic uncertainty.
tip: 가격/수치 변동 → fluctuate / 다양하다 → vary / 교대하다 → alternate

title: 분사 - 현재분사 (능동 수식)
explanation: 명사 'firms'가 능동적으로 '경쟁하는' 주체이므로 현재분사 'competing'을 사용한다. competed(과거분사), competition(명사), competitive(형용사)는 명사 뒤 능동 수식에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Several firms competing for the government contract submitted their proposals well before the official deadline for submissions.
incorrectExample: Several firms competed for the government contract submitted their proposals well before the official deadline for submissions.
tip: 명사 + ___ + 전치사 (능동) → 현재분사(V-ing)

title: 연어 - conduct a survey
explanation: '설문조사를 실시하다'라는 연어 'conduct a survey'가 필요하다. perform(수행하다), do(하다), hold(개최하다)는 survey와 자연스러운 연어가 아니다.
correctExample: The research department plans to conduct a comprehensive survey to assess employee satisfaction with the current benefits package.
incorrectExample: The research department plans to perform a comprehensive survey to assess employee satisfaction with the current benefits package.
tip: 조사 실시 → conduct a survey/study/research

title: 품사 - 부사 자리 (완료형 수식)
explanation: 현재완료 'have been allocated'를 수식하는 자리에는 부사 'adequately'가 필요하다. adequate(형용사), adequacy(명사), inadequately(부사, 반의어)는 동사구를 수식할 수 없거나 의미가 다르다.
correctExample: The project manager confirmed that sufficient resources have been adequately allocated to each phase of the development project.
incorrectExample: The project manager confirmed that sufficient resources have been adequate allocated to each phase of the development project.
tip: have been + ___ + p.p. → 부사

title: 전치사 - notwithstanding (~에도 불구하고)
explanation: '~에도 불구하고'라는 뜻의 격식체 전치사 'notwithstanding'이 필요하다. regardless(부사), nevertheless(접속부사), although(접속사)는 뒤에 명사를 직접 이끌 수 없거나 격식 문맥에 부적절하다.
correctExample: Notwithstanding the initial delays in construction, the new corporate headquarters was completed within the original budget estimate.
incorrectExample: Nevertheless the initial delays in construction, the new corporate headquarters was completed within the original budget estimate.
tip: ___ + 명사(구) → notwithstanding/despite/in spite of

title: 어휘 - mandate vs recommend
explanation: mandate는 '의무화하다/명령하다'의 뜻으로 강제적 규정 문맥에 적합하다. recommend(권장하다), suggest(제안하다), propose(제의하다)는 강제성이 없다.
correctExample: Federal regulations mandate that all publicly traded companies disclose their financial statements to investors on a quarterly basis.
incorrectExample: Federal regulations recommend that all publicly traded companies disclose their financial statements to investors on a quarterly basis.
tip: 의무화/강제 → mandate / 권장 → recommend / 제안 → suggest

title: 가정법 - 혼합 가정법
explanation: 과거 사실의 반대(If + had p.p.)가 현재에 영향(would + V)을 미치는 혼합 가정법이다. If invested(가정법 과거), If invests(직설법), If will invest(미래)는 혼합 가정법에 부적절하다.
correctExample: If the firm had invested in cybersecurity infrastructure years ago, it would not be facing such severe data breach issues today.
incorrectExample: If the firm invested in cybersecurity infrastructure years ago, it would not be facing such severe data breach issues today.
tip: 과거 가정 → 현재 결과: If + had p.p., S + would + V(원형)
distractors: invested in cybersecurity infrastructure,has invested in cybersecurity infrastructure,will invest in cybersecurity infrastructure

title: 어휘 - juxtapose vs compare
explanation: juxtapose는 '(대조를 위해) 나란히 놓다'라는 고급 어휘이다. compare(비교하다), contrast(대조하다), correlate(상관시키다)는 나란히 배치의 뉘앙스가 아니다.
correctExample: The report juxtaposed the financial performance of the two divisions to highlight the differences in their growth trajectories.
incorrectExample: The report correlated the financial performance of the two divisions to highlight the differences in their growth trajectories.
tip: 대조 위해 나란히 놓다 → juxtapose / 비교 → compare / 상관 → correlate

title: 가정법 - should 도치 (격식체)
explanation: If를 생략하고 should를 문두로 도치한 격식체 가정법이다. 'Should any issues arise'가 올바르다.
correctExample: Should any issues arise during the implementation phase, the project manager must be notified immediately for prompt resolution.
incorrectExample: If any issues will arise during the implementation phase, the project manager must be notified immediately for prompt resolution.
tip: If S + should → Should + S + V(원형) (격식 도치)
distractors: If any issues will arise,Any issues should arise,Issues should any arise

title: 어휘 - preclude vs prevent
explanation: preclude는 '(가능성을) 배제하다, 불가능하게 하다'의 격식 어휘로 부정적 결과를 표현한다. enable(가능하게 하다), allow(허용하다), facilitate(용이하게 하다)는 모두 긍정적 결과를 나타내므로 '예산 제약'이라는 부정적 원인과 의미상 충돌하여 오답이다.
correctExample: The severe budget constraints may preclude the company from pursuing the proposed expansion into emerging markets this year.
incorrectExample: The severe budget constraints may enable the company from pursuing the proposed expansion into emerging markets this year.
tip: preclude = 가능성 배제(격식). 예산 제약 → 확장 불가 → preclude! enable/allow/facilitate는 반대 의미로 명백히 오답!

title: 가정법 - 제안동사 insist + that + 원형
explanation: 제안/요구 동사 'insisted' 뒤의 that절에서는 동사원형 'attend'를 사용한다. attends(현재 3인칭), attended(과거), would attend(조건)는 제안동사 뒤 that절에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The director insisted that every team member attend the mandatory compliance training session scheduled for next Monday morning.
incorrectExample: The director insisted that every team member attends the mandatory compliance training session scheduled for next Monday morning.
tip: insist/demand/require + that + S + V(원형) [should 생략]

title: 어휘 - commensurate vs comparable
explanation: commensurate는 '(가치/수준이) 상응하는'의 뜻으로 급여와 경험의 상응 관계를 나타낸다. comparable(비교 가능한), competitive(경쟁력 있는), compatible(호환 가능한)는 상응의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: The salary offered for this senior position is commensurate with the candidate's level of experience and professional qualifications.
incorrectExample: The salary offered for this senior position is comparable with the candidate's level of experience and professional qualifications.
tip: ~에 상응하는 → commensurate with / 비교 가능 → comparable to

title: 도치 - 부정어 문두 (Seldom)
explanation: 부정어 'Seldom'이 문두에 오면 도치가 일어나 '조동사 + 주어' 어순이 된다. 'has the company faced'가 올바르다.
correctExample: Seldom has the company faced such a significant challenge in meeting its production targets as it did during the last quarter.
incorrectExample: Seldom the company has faced such a significant challenge in meeting its production targets as it did during the last quarter.
tip: Seldom/Rarely/Never + 조동사 + S + V → 도치
distractors: the company has faced,the company faced,did the company facing

title: 어휘 - circumvent vs avoid
explanation: circumvent는 '(규제/장애를) 우회하다/회피하다'의 격식 어휘이다. avoid(피하다, 일반적), evade(회피하다, 부정적), bypass(우회하다, 물리적)는 규제 우회의 격식 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The company attempted to circumvent the trade restrictions by establishing subsidiary operations in countries with favorable agreements.
incorrectExample: The company attempted to evade the trade restrictions by establishing subsidiary operations in countries with favorable agreements.
tip: 규제/절차 우회 → circumvent / 일반 회피 → avoid / 탈세 등 불법 회피 → evade

title: 가정법 - were to (미래 가능성 낮은 가정)
explanation: 미래에 일어날 가능성이 낮은 상황을 가정할 때 'were to + V'를 사용한다. will decide(직설법 미래), decides(현재), decided(과거)는 가능성 낮은 가정에 부적절하다.
correctExample: If the board were to decide against the merger, the company would need to explore other strategies for long-term growth.
incorrectExample: If the board will decide against the merger, the company would need to explore other strategies for long-term growth.
tip: 미래 가능성 낮은 가정 → If + S + were to + V

title: 어휘 - disseminate vs distribute
explanation: disseminate는 '(정보/지식을) 널리 퍼뜨리다'의 격식 어휘이다. distribute(배포하다, 물리적), disperse(흩뜨리다), dismiss(기각하다)는 정보 전파의 뉘앙스가 다르다.
correctExample: The communications department is responsible for disseminating important corporate policy updates to all regional office branches.
incorrectExample: The communications department is responsible for dispersing important corporate policy updates to all regional office branches.
tip: 정보 전파 → disseminate / 물건 배포 → distribute / 흩뜨리다 → disperse

title: 연어 - exercise caution
explanation: '주의를 기울이다'라는 고급 연어 'exercise caution'이 정답이다. make caution(주의를 만들다)은 영어에 존재하지 않는 비문이다. practice caution(주의를 연습하다)은 논리적으로 어색하며, perform caution(주의를 수행하다)도 caution과 자연스러운 연어를 이루지 않는다. 'exercise caution'은 TOEIC Part 5/7에서 반복 등장하는 핵심 비즈니스 연어이므로 암기가 필수이다.
correctExample: Investors are advised to exercise caution when evaluating the financial projections of newly established technology startup companies.
incorrectExample: Investors are advised to make caution when evaluating the financial projections of newly established technology startup companies.
tip: 주의를 기울이다 → exercise caution / 재량권 행사 → exercise discretion

title: 시제 - 과거완료 수동 (이중 과거)
explanation: 주절보다 앞선 과거에 수동으로 완료된 동작이므로 과거완료 수동 'had been allocated'를 사용한다. was allocated(과거 수동), has been allocated(현재완료 수동), were allocating(과거 진행 능동)은 이중 과거 수동에 부적절하다.
correctExample: The project was canceled because the funds that had been allocated to it were redirected to more urgent infrastructure repairs.
incorrectExample: The project was canceled because the funds that were allocated to it were redirected to more urgent infrastructure repairs.
tip: 주절 과거 + 종속절 더 앞선 과거 + 수동 → had been + p.p.

title: 어휘 - proliferation vs production
explanation: proliferation은 '(급속한) 확산/증식'의 뜻으로 기술 확산 문맥에 적합하다. production(생산), proportion(비율), proposition(제안)은 급속 확산의 의미가 아니다.
correctExample: The proliferation of mobile payment platforms has fundamentally transformed consumer purchasing behavior in the retail industry.
incorrectExample: The production of mobile payment platforms has fundamentally transformed consumer purchasing behavior in the retail industry.
tip: 급속 확산 → proliferation / 생산 → production / 비율 → proportion

title: 가정법 - Had 도치 (격식체 과거완료)
explanation: If를 생략하고 Had를 문두로 도치한 격식체 가정법 과거완료이다. 'Had the management acted'가 올바르다.
correctExample: Had the management acted on the auditor's recommendations sooner, the financial losses could have been significantly minimized.
